design_notes: Resolution happens strictly at request time (beginRequest copies the source's current value): install performs no resolution and no source effect, so nothing pre-resolved can go stale across a restart (ruling R30).

The installed marker is a session-scoped ratchet (the restored scope always carries the full slot set), while in-flight captures are residency-scoped and cleared by the explicit restart-boundary drop hook.
Selection captures are copies ({ ...current }), so a shared mutable object cannot corrupt an in-flight capture.
The adapter never writes the source: the operator/control-plane owns mutations (the overlay only resolves); the source is the sole owner of the in-effect selection.
The local ModelSelection contract is a lossless structural mirror of the public upstream ModelSelection interface (reasoningEffort widened to string); T5/T6 binds the real seam.
